dataset_name: Curated Empirical Food Shelf Life Dataset
description: Comprehensive food science dataset modeling food degradation kinetics using the Arrhenius temperature relation, Q10 microbial spoilage coefficients, water activity / relative humidity effects, and packaging permeability factors across 6 food categories.

features.food_category: Categorical: Dairy, Meat & Poultry, Seafood, Fruits, Vegetables, Bakery
features.storage_temperature_c: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius (range -20°C to 40°C)
features.packaging_type: Categorical: Vacuum Sealed, Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP), Sealed Plastic Container, Paper / Carton, Ambient / Unsealed
features.initial_quality_index: Numerical index (1.0 to 10.0) reflecting post-processing/harvest freshness
features.storage_duration_days: Number of days the food product has already spent under storage conditions

scientific_foundation: Arrhenius equation k(T) = k0 * exp(-Ea / RT), Labuza sorption isotherm moisture relations, and empirical packaging barrier ratios.
